links.outcome: General-purpose multimodal model sensitivity, specificity, AUC for Ficat-Arlet staging of femoral head AVN on radiographs
links.effect: Micro-averaged sensitivity 25.8%, specificity 79.5%, mean AUC 0.55 across all FA stages; highest sensitivity Stage 0 (54.2%), lowest Stage 4 (10.4%).
links.quote: ChatGPT-4o achieved a micro-averaged sensitivity of 25.8%, specificity of 79.5%, and mean AUC of 0.55 across all FA stages.

screen.reason: Retrospective benchmark evaluating the diagnostic performance of a general-purpose multimodal vision-language model (GPT-4o) on radiographic staging of femoral head osteonecrosis without testing a deployment practice or guardrail.
